judge.voice: B1 is fair, and I believe it. The corrections were real ones. It quoted "for large order" and "if the price stay" from my own answers, and it didn't treat me as Czech or as a refugee. That is what I wanted. The check took about seven minutes and every task was clear. But I told it three times that I have an interview on Friday. It then gave me only carrier-call tasks, with no "tell me about a problem you solved". That is what the interviewer will ask me. The summary is nice but a bit general. I would come back to try the interview situation, and I would tell a colleague about it. For Friday I need real interview rehearsal, not just a level.
